title: Terminal
description: A green phosphor screen asks "shall we play a record?" and lists the Beatles albums like a 1983 menu, with number rain trickling down the margins. Open a record and its cover rasters in dither while the tracklist types out, then a now-playing line and a character spectrum with falling peaks start up; leave the menu alone and it drifts into a screensaver of a spinning ASCII record, flowing slashes and dithered plasma.
intent: One old screen made beautiful, now with generative character art living inside it: a ray-cast ASCII vinyl whose groove gaps match the album's track count, a flow field drawn in slashes, a Bayer-dithered plasma, a peak-hold spectrum and digit rain, all through the same CRT pass (curvature, scanlines, bloom, phosphor persistence).
sources: herb reference board: fa23 Y2K montage (green CRT terminal text, menu list)
